outcomes.why: It is the opening of the page — eyebrow label, one big line, and a supporting sentence — rather than a standalone assertion mid-page, which would be Statement.
Same opening-the-room structure at the top of the write-up, naming which room it is; a Statement would be a line inside the argument rather than the page's first thing.
A single quotable line the essay turns on, not something needing a status mark or evidence, which would make it a Claim.
A full-width turn in the argument that a reader would quote, rather than a testable belief owing evidence (Claim).
It is a defensible, falsifiable belief explicitly carrying an open/testing status, not merely a rhetorical turn (Statement).
A stated position that could be shown false and is marked unproven — the status mark is what makes it a Claim rather than a Statement.
It reports what is actually there — a spike at a named time — before arguing what causes it, which would make it a Claim.
A short labelled report of what was found in the field ('rules rewritten on paper'), noticing rather than arguing (Claim).
It is the question a reader would type plus a liftable short paragraph, not the claim at display size (Statement).
The literal customer question with a self-contained paragraph a stranger could lift whole — the defining test for Answer.
Someone else's prose quoted verbatim with its trims noted; it is prose from a letter, not code or output (Snippet).
Words that are not ours, keeping their own markdown, emphasis and named source — prose rather than code (Snippet).
The code and its literal output where paraphrasing would be a lie; there is no live executor behind it, so not Terminal.
The verbatim payload shown exactly as it arrives so integrators can match fields — showing the output itself rather than quoting a person (Excerpt).
Findings behind a claim where one prediction failed — different facts each with date and sample size, not the same fact checked twice (Agreement).
Measured findings with confirmations and contradictions side by side, making the claim checkable rather than stating it (Claim).
Three independently derived values of the same fact that must be identical, with a mismatch as a named failure — not separate facts (Evidence).
Three independent authorities counting the same quantity and required to match exactly, which is the same-fact-twice test rather than assorted findings.
The final level folds down a graded scale by caps so nobody asserts it, rather than being measured (Evidence).
A certification arrived at by starting high and dropping a level per flagged element — capped folding down a scale, not a measured number.
First published, last changed, and the build behind what you are reading — the record behind the work rather than a pasteable reference (Citation).
Commit, dataset version and sign-off date date the report's claims; it is the build record, not something a reader cites (Citation).
A pasteable reference so someone can cite this published object in their own paper, rather than the build record behind it (Provenance).
A copyable reference in bibliography formats — letting someone cite you, not showing what the work was built from (Provenance).
The system is declining to act correctly and should read as a deliberate decision, not an unresolved matter (Question) or an error.
A designed decline showing what was asked, what was available, and the rule that stopped it — a refusal, not an open question.
Nobody is declining anything; the matter is genuinely unresolved and printed at full size rather than buried, which is the Question test.
An unresolved matter printed at full size at the chapter's end; it does not open the next chapter's door, so not Connection.
Physically present alternatives of one identity, with a designed refusal for the absent RAW — one identity's forms, not two interpretations (Comparison).
Three stocked cuts of one garment plus a designed refusal for the discontinued fourth, rather than an empty slot or a comparison of interpretations.
Each rung is closed by its own criterion, in order, with none skippable — governing what may happen next rather than recording what happened (Timeline).
Phases gated by named endpoints that must close before the next may open — prerequisite governance, not a dated history.
One object cut open with every layer labelled and nothing behind a click, rather than taken apart step by step by the reader (Decomposition).
A labelled section with all layers visible at once; disclosure is simultaneous, not reader-paced (Decomposition).
The reader controls the pace of taking the dish apart; if the parts arrived on their own it would be Unfolding.
A whole broken into its parts and the assembling rule, explicitly advanced by the reader rather than performing itself (Unfolding).
On-screen width means actual field width in the artifact, which is the physical-layout-to-scale test rather than a labelled cutaway (Anatomy).
A physical layout drawn to scale, each region as wide as it really is, rather than a labelled anatomy of parts.
One subject at three depths on one URL — explanation, working object, and statute clause — which is registers of one explanation, not parts of one object (Anatomy).
Same dish at several depths on one URL with a remembered preference; the choices are registers of one subject rather than alternative stocked forms (Variants).
A large field where each input lights only a small subset and the rest stay dormant, which is the defining ExpertField behaviour rather than a routing path (FollowReveal).
Hundreds of specialists with only a handful waking per question — most stays dormant and which part activates depends on the input.
A stream is widened into many phrasings, judged, and compressed back to one — the argument lives in the widths, unlike Compilation where distinct inputs merge into a new whole.
Same expand-judge-compress shape applied to applicants; the pool is deliberately widened and narrowed rather than many separate inputs fusing into one output.
There is a real executor answering queries live, not a recording, which would make it a Film.
A prompt with scrollback returning results from the actual index is a live query surface rather than a played recording.
Each link names the relation that brought it there, which is the path's shape — not just the doors out of a chapter, which would be Connection.
A replayed trail where every hop is labelled with why it follows is the path between connected ideas, not an exit link.
The reader drags between two interpretations of one object, so the pace belongs to them rather than to a performed swap.
Two readings of one product with the reader moving between them is reader-paced interpretation, not a self-performing Transformation.
It performs itself as the reader arrives and explicitly never dissolves one state into the other — a staged swap, not a reader-dragged Comparison.
Two states of one balance sheet changing on their own when scrolled into view is performed rather than reader-operated.
The parts arrive on their own as the reader watches, rather than the reader controlling the pace, which would be Decomposition.
Components appear in sequence without being clicked, so it is performed rather than operated.
Twelve inputs lose their separateness in a single dossier, unlike Procession where one thing passes through stages and stays itself.
Many raw responses merge into one published figure and stop being separable, which is compilation rather than a single object's journey.
It is the same parcel at the end, having been somewhere, rather than many inputs fusing into one.
One manuscript passes through every stage in order and remains itself at the end.
Each step is ten times bigger and rescales the world — powers of ten rather than a bar chart or a staged journey.
Zooming out an order of magnitude at a time is a scale nobody can hold in their head, not a throughput constraint.
The fixed-diameter pipe is the constraint and the whole story, so the conduit rather than the quantity is the subject.
A fixed number of lines caps throughput as demand rises — capacity as conduit, not a matter of scale.
Values snapped onto a sixteen-colour lattice with the loss itself as the subject rather than a claim about it.
Continuous salary data snapped into five bands, with what falls between them being the loss on display.
A real two-minute film exists and is being played in the flow of the chapter.
An actual recorded walkthrough is played inside the article, and a recording of something is a Film rather than a live Terminal.
One sentence raising the next chapter plus links out is the chapter's exit, not the labelled shape of a path.
It points at the next pages with a line explaining why, which is the doors out of the chapter rather than a traced route.
Every line carries a date and records what happened, rather than governing what may happen next as a Ladder would.
Entry-by-entry history with a year on each line, belonging to the subject rather than to one published object's record.
It owes no evidence and is where the argument turns — the quotable line — rather than a testable belief needing a status mark.
It could be shown false and the reader should see it is not yet settled, so it needs a status — unlike a Statement, which owes nothing.
It reports what the recordings show and explicitly defers what it means to the next section, stopping short of arguing.
Two independently derived values must be identical and a mismatch is a named failure, rather than different facts as Evidence would be.
Four separate findings including ones that refuted expectations are the receipts behind a claim, not the same fact checked twice.
One report read two ways with the reader moving at their own speed is reader-paced interpretation, not registers of one explanation on one URL.
Two states of one landscape performing the change on their own and resting on a designed final state, rather than a reader-dragged Comparison.
The reader clicks through each stage at their own pace, controlling the take-apart, rather than watching parts arrive.
Identical props to Decomposition, but the components arrive by themselves as the section scrolls — the reader watches rather than operates.
It is the question as a customer would type it with a liftable short paragraph beneath, rather than a claim at display size.
The words are someone else's contract prose reproduced verbatim, and prose rather than code keeps it out of Snippet.
It is code reproduced exactly as run, where paraphrasing would be a lie.
The page is declining to assert deliberately and correctly, rather than leaving an unresolved matter open as a Question does.
Nobody is declining anything — the matter is genuinely unresolved and printed at full size instead of footnoted.
It dates and versions this one published document rather than narrating the policy area's history, which would be Timeline.
Every entry is a dated event in the subject's history, not the record behind a single published object.
Each stage is a gate closed by its own criterion in order with none skippable, which governs what may happen next rather than recording what happened.
One object stays itself through every stage in order, unlike Compilation where inputs lose their separateness.
One object is cut open with all its regions labelled and everything disclosed at once, rather than taken apart step by step.
Drawn width on screen equals actual field width in the artifact, which is the scale-fidelity test rather than a labelled cutaway.
It is the reference to a published object someone can quote in their own work, not the build record behind it.
Two interpretations of one object with a control the reader drags, rather than a self-performing staged swap.
These are physically present alternatives of one identity and the absent fourth deserves a designed refusal.
The constraint is the conduit itself — the road's fixed capacity — rather than a scale or a snapped lattice.
Each arrival rescales the world by powers of a thousand, which is the unholdable-scale test rather than throughput against capacity.
Many inputs lose their separateness in the final sauce, unlike Procession where one thing stays itself.
The guide, the tool and the legal text are registers of one subject on a single URL, not parts of one object.
It opens the room, names which room it is, and is the first thing on the page.
The argument lives in the widths — generate wide, judge candidate by candidate, compress survivors — rather than in inputs merging.
The final figure folds down a graded scale by caps so nobody asserts it, rather than being measured.
It is the checkable findings behind a claim with per-row provenance, not the belief itself.
The sentence could be shown false and needs a status mark, which outweighs its role as a turn in the argument.
The parts arrive on their own as the reader scrolls — watching, not operating at their own chosen pace.
The words are the regulator's verbatim and keep their own source and trims, rather than being a paragraph written for the asker.
It is the system declining to assert, correctly and by design, rather than an unresolved open matter.
It records dated approvals that already happened, whereas Ladder would govern what may happen next.
An answer plus its supporting passage plus a confidence value is a composite output, and no single vocabulary form covers all three registers at once.
The same total derived by independent authorities must be identical and the mismatch is the named failure.
Summary, mechanism and raw data are depths of one explanation on one subject, not parts of an object.
A claim passes through the insurer's stages in order as the same claim, rather than each stage gating the next by a closed criterion.
It is the quotable line the room is about, printed at display size, without owing evidence or a status mark.
A flat catalogue of eight peer promises is neither one object cut open nor a set of alternatives of one identity, so no form fits.
A shopping cart is ordinary transactional UI, not any assertion, evidence, or explanatory form in this vocabulary.
A login screen is application chrome with nothing being asserted, shown, or explained.
Grouped toggles are a settings interface, not an anatomy or any other form here.
A sortable paginated data grid is a UI control surface, not evidence marshalled behind a claim.
A constrained date picker is an input widget, with no assertion or demonstration involved.
A transient success toast is interface feedback, not a statement or an animated demonstration.
Pricing tiers are commercial UI; Variants concerns physically present forms of one identity, not purchase options.
A progress bar reports position in a flow rather than governing gated steps as a Ladder does.
A clustering pin map is a navigational UI, not a to-scale layout or any explanatory form here.
A live threaded chat is a messaging interface, not an excerpt, terminal, or any vocabulary form.
A draggable month calendar is a scheduling tool, not a dated history told in order.
A file uploader with progress is an input control, not a demonstration of something happening as an argument.
